source_note: Labour Code of the Republic of Armenia ՀՕ-124-Ն (arlis.am redaction 23.12.2022-06.04.2023; owner confirmed current 22 Nov 2026). Quotes and article reading in docs/legal/PRE_REVIEW.md. Lawyer must confirm.
basis: Art. 170(1): replacing annual leave with cash is not allowed; cash is paid only when the contract ends and the leave cannot be granted (or the employee does not want it). Art. 170(1.1): contracts under Art. 100/101 and employees under six months.

title.hy: Տարեկան արձակուրդը փոխարինվել է դրամական փոխհատուցմամբ
title.en: Annual leave was replaced with cash

edge_cases: Payment for unused leave on termination is allowed (Art. 170(1)), so terminated employees are excluded.
